draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.98, the 153rd-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 20th of 32 at WR. He went 50th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (153rd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Greg Ward. Testing concerns: 10-yard split (16th percentile), vertical jump (16th percentile). College production: 636 receiving yards in 2022, 22nd of 32 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Green Bay Packers (reserve). 40 career games and 26 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 2 AV in 2025 against a career-best 9 in 2023. Played 7 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-3 wide receiver who played: 207 receiving yards against a median of 346, below the norm.
